limitations: Original and restart have different task/filtering/repair histories; changes cannot be attributed solely to the audited wording.

Only five calibration targets were directly user-rated; other targets/proposals are assistant extrapolations.
Constant learning rates used without warmup or decay. Later deterioration does not isolate schedule versus overfitting; user deferred schedule test until after reviewing this run.
No generation flags means decoding completed, not that meanings are correct.
